Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and next steps — Redwood pilot

Jamie —

Great to meet you and the team on today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Recap from discovery:
  • Use case: Aurora wants to deploy summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for internal docs with sub-200ms p95 latency for 1–2k users.
  • Success metrics: latency < 300ms p95 in production, cost target ~ $0.002/token (pilot SLA), and no PII persisted outside VPC.
  • Technical constraints: must pass SOC2-ish security checklist and procurement requires a signed MSA + PO.

- Immediate asks from our side:
  1) Confirm economic buyer / budget owner for this initiative so we can loop them into the mutual action plan.
  2) Procurement contact and any standard terms they require (PO, PO net days, insurance limits).
  3) Security questionnaire owner so we can start the responses.

- Proposed next steps:
  • Alex/Marissa: prepare a one-page cost estimate + mutual action plan (attached).
  • Jamie: intro to budget owner (or share contact) and procurement.
  • Goal: pilot kickoff by Jan 10; procurement + security cleared by then.

I attached the draft Mutual Action Plan and an initial SOW outline for your review — these are intentionally light and focused on timelines and owners. If you can introduce the budget owner (or confirm who that is), I'll reach out with a short note and tailored pricing.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Alex —

Thanks for the clear recap and for the MAP. Quick answers from my side: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Ethan Wang, Director of Finance (ethan.wang@auroratech.com). He owns budget for platform/AI tooling.
- Procurement: procurement@auroratech.com handles contracts and POs; typical lead time is 2–3 weeks for standard SOWs, longer if legal redlines MSA.
- Security: security-questionnaires@auroratech.com is the intake; they typically want a completed vendor security questionnaire + SOC2 report.

I can do a short intro to Ethan (internal) — would you prefer me to loop him in directly or should I give you his email for a separate outreach? Also, for procurement: they usually ask for a one-pager cost estimate + draft SOW to kick things off.

One more note: our legal lead may push for a data residency clause; happy to discuss.
